answer: For juniper canopy, umber soil and nebula spectra sold by agents, propose insured claims: each paid identity needs a 90-day policy backed by unique on-ledger escrow worth 20 times its capped payout. Independent labs audit raw data; if fabrication is proven, the insurer pays buyers from that escrow. Proposed validators check exclusive coin locks and deny unfunded or duplicate policies. A farm can finance all policies through one lender, but each extra key ties up another full escrow for 90 days; loans cannot reuse locked coins. No cover means no pay. This requires new rules, not MinePoA today.
